items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: But Walcox, I don't know from him either. Yeah, he was from Xavier College, but he was around with different bands.

ctx.x: Great person. And drums. I had drummers, eh?
The drums we had. Lewis and Paul Barbaran always had been outstanding drummers this time. Bass class. We didn't talk about that. Chester, Cleo, or Walcox. We had Ransom.
Ransom Nolan, I met him once. Yeah.
